vb_textbox.text: Hello FriendAfter taking part in the game myself, I'd like to try and give you some helpful tips to help you succeed in the game and gain more bonus points.The aim of the game is to collect the most mushrooms. The number of mushrooms is decided by a multiplier either x1 or x5 which is randomly selected and has no signifance other than the amount you end up with.What you do need to know is that the different coloured gnomes always appear together in the following groups - red and yellow - orange and brown - green and pink - blue and purple. These groups appear randomly but always grouped in the the above colours together.There are two different forests they will take you to, a lighter coloured one and a darker coloured one but the number of available mushrooms will change.In my experience, by clicking on specific coloured gnomes will take you to the best forests and give you the highest number of mushrooms regardless of the multiplier that has been selected at the beginning. This is important - memorize this ---- the best gnomes to choose are as follows - YELLOW- GREEN-ORANGE-BLUEoccasionally you may receive 0 mushrooms from choosing these coloured gnomes but stick with it and you will do well. By using this system I accumulated over 3,000 points. Good luck :-)
